name: Colcu

attributes.attribute: a name borne by several early Irish figures and saints
stepson of the fairy queen Créd

text: Colcu, also Colga, is a name that several figures of old Ireland carried, saints among them. The most famous Colcu was stepson to the fairy queen Créd. He blocked her plan for a love affair with Cano, and the tale lives on in saga and in verse. See Créd.

okr.objective: Colcu names several early Irish figures, best known as the stepson of Créd.
key_results: Colcu, also Colga, is a name borne by several figures of early Irish tradition and some saints.
The most famous Colcu, stepson of Créd, of the fairy queen Créd and stopped her planned affair with Cano.
okr.evidence: MacKillop, Dictionary of Celtic Mythology, s.v. Colcu
